name: UF-style-outline
note: outline — bold outline, readable silhouette. 128x128 on a plain background (a cut-out would eat the outline). — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 1. Twin of FACTORY/style-outline.  (sample: seed 1217)

form.subject: a (fox adventurer:1.3) with a (backpack:1.1) and a walking stick, full body
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (multiple, sprite sheet, collage:1.3), cropped

sample_command: pixelmon 'a (fox adventurer:1.3) with a (backpack:1.1) and a walking stick, full body' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora pixel-art-xl.safetensors --lora-strength 1 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (multiple, sprite sheet, collage:1.3), cropped' --style outline,solo --out 128x128 --palette none --despeckle 1 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --pixel-size 1x1 --seed 1217
